run_symbol_database_tests: run the unittest test suite for google.protobuf.symbol_database to verify registration and lookup
test_GetSymbol: test the SymbolDatabase GetSymbol method to look up a protobuf message by fully qualified name
test_GetMessages: test the SymbolDatabase GetMessages method to retrieve all messages registered for a proto file
test_GetPrototype: test the SymbolDatabase GetPrototype method to get a message class from its descriptor
test_descriptor_pool_lookups: test the descriptor pool methods FindMessageTypeByName, FindEnumTypeByName, FindServiceByName, and FindFileContainingSymbol
